change: Removed root $schema and description fields for Claude Code 2.1.116 compatibility.
Removed displayName from generated entries because Claude Code 2.1.116 rejects the newer field.
Omitted homepage when the source identifier is not an absolute HTTP URL.
Exposed each retained skill as a separately ranked marketplace entry with Chinese capability metadata, Chinese description, and skills.sh download count.

Localized the description field in each Grok-readable plugin.json manifest so Grok's marketplace scanner cannot replace the Chinese marketplace description with the upstream English manifest description.
reason: Grok prioritizes the plugin manifest description when browsing available marketplace plugins; each record in the details file preserves the original value, localized value, path, and reason.
